text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since the Osaka Hai.
Before we even have the time to catch our
breath, Satono Diamond is
flying out the gates of
the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Another Umamusume's stumble
has forced
Satono Daimond to the
outside!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aaand she's taken third! The favorite to
win,
Satono Diamond, is unable to meet
those
expectations and takes third!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's waited so long for a shot at
running in a G1
race. I can't blame her
for feeling depressed...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This... This is exactly why the jinx is
worth
breaking...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's held the Satono family back for so
long. Were
it so easy to break, someone
would have done so
ages ago.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The competition is stronger than normal,
and I'm
at a disadvantage against them.
But I knew all of
that already.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm here... Next time, I will fulfill my duty!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia... You're right. There's no point
getting hung
up on stuff like this. That
goes for me, too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect anything less from a
member of the Satono Group. True to
her name, she really
has a heart as hardy
as a diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I lost today, but I'm not going to let it
stop me.
I'm going to keep working
toward the Derby, so
please...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Do your best in your next race, you two.
That is
the best encouragement I can ask
for.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
For sure! My next race will come before
yours, so
I promise to run with all my
heart for you!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best, Kitasan.
Yeah, let's do our best, Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though they run in different races, they
continue to challenge and encourage
each other upon their parallel paths.
Their spring has become even more
intense.
